call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Can you provide granular unit economics on the Austin Robotaxi pilot rides and clarify whether the $15B FY26 CapEx is a new baseline run-rate or a one-off AI supercomputing spike?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.management_response: Elon Musk & CFO Vaibhav Taneja clarified that operating costs for Cybercab in the geofenced Austin commercial fleet are already operating under $0.25 per mile, factoring in cleaning, charging, and maintenance. On CapEx, management noted that ~$4B of the FY26 expenditure represents high-density GPU cluster delivery (Cortex) which should plateau in mid-2027 before self-funding via FSD subscription cash flows.
call_qa_forensic_highlights.forensic_takeaway: Management was notably transparent on robotaxi unit economics, but signaled that FCF will remain constrained through mid-2027 due to sustained AI infrastructure buildouts.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Regarding the 245 bps snapback in automotive gross margin ex-credits: How much of that was structural factory efficiencies versus temporary raw material tailwinds that could reverse?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.management_response: CFO Taneja detailed that roughly 160 bps of the 245 bps improvement stemmed from permanent structural manufacturing gains: localization of supply chain in Berlin and Austin, lower sub-assembly scrap rates, and 4680 cell cost curves falling below supplier cathode costs. The remaining ~85 bps was raw material indexing (lithium and nickel).
call_qa_forensic_highlights.forensic_takeaway: Confirms that automotive margins have likely carved out a durable cyclical bottom above 16.5%, giving the company substantial breathing room heading into the 2027 model refresh.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: What is the limiting gating factor for scaling energy storage deployments further in 2027—is it customer demand, grid interconnection queues, or LFP battery cell availability?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.management_response: Musk emphasized that utility demand is effectively infinite given data center electrification bottlenecks. The primary bottleneck in Q3 was stationary LFP cell supply, but with the Nevada LFP facility now producing domestic cells and Megafactory Texas online, supply constraints will largely ease by Q1 2027.
call_qa_forensic_highlights.forensic_takeaway: Energy storage is transitioning from a supply-constrained bottleneck into a high-margin, multi-billion-dollar recurring cash cow.
